title: Massachusetts naloxone prescribing and dispensing
rule_summary: Naloxone may lawfully be prescribed and dispensed to a person at risk or to another person positioned to assist, and Massachusetts pharmacy pathways include standing-order and reporting provisions.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply opioid antagonist requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing opioid antagonist with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
